name: Touch Theory
source:
Mad scientist Zeggy is stuck in his "lab" when suddenly he gets a very intriguing (and sexy) visitor!

Why is this visitor here? When will he leave? Can Zeggy kiss him?

What happens when the relationship gets serious, and something SERIOUSLY bad happens?

Made in celebration of Halloween, this kinetic novel focuses on an alternate reality featuring characters from [url=/p6006]DarkChibiShadow[/url]'s comic, Space School. You do not need to have read Space School in order to play an enjoy this game, though it is encouraged.

[Edited from [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/touch-theory]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
疯狂科学家泽吉被困在他的“实验室”里，一位极其吸引人（也很性感）的访客突然上门！

访客为什么来这里？什么时候才会离开？泽吉能吻他吗？

当两人的关系认真起来，而一场极其严重的坏事发生时，会怎样？

这部为庆祝万圣节创作的线性小说，讲述《Space School》漫画角色们置身于平行世界的故事。游玩前不必读过《Space School》，不过读过会更好。

[摘编自[url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/touch-theory]Itch.io[/url]]
